title: Jedi unveiled
description: Leia rescues Han Solo from his carbon-freeze nightmare, but is surprised by the gloating Jabba and his minions, who take the young heroes prisoner. Jabba even forces Leia to wear a slave outfit, and chains the humiliated princess to his throne. Finally, Luke Skywalker arrives to bring an end to Jabba's actions. No longer a callow farmboy, the young Skywalker is formidable, every inch a Jedi. He proves his power in a spectacular battle with the palace rancor, a monstrous creature retained in a pit directly below the throne room. Skywalker succeeds in vanquishing this beast, and is promptly sentenced to death...
